decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets identified: (1) early multi-sample rise in N/E/U (365–375) with sustained elevation but no confirmed return; (2) sharp jump at 490–491 with complex post-jump motion and no observed reversal within window. Both lack unambiguous opposing returns; status marked uncertain. No confirmed temporary intervals.

intervals.observation: N rises from ~-0.89 to ~2.44 (index 365→372), E shifts from ~-0.53 to ~0.46 (365→372), U peaks near index 370 (~1.9) then declines; onset is multi-sample, sustained elevated N/E through index 375, but no opposing return observed within allowed context (ends at 579); return ambiguous due to coarse sampling and continued variability.

At index 490–491, N jumps from ~2.9 to ~5.08, E drops sharply from ~-0.36 to ~-2.44, U rises from ~1.49 to ~3.53; post-jump, N remains elevated (>2.9) through index 492, E stays negative, U fluctuates but does not return toward pre-jump levels by index 492; no clear opposing return observed before index 492, and subsequent behavior includes further jumps (e.g., index 500: N=7.07), preventing isolation of a closed temporary offset.
